title: Hot Spins
summary: A 1-in-80 base spin runs HOT: every reel holding a wild expands to a full wild reel and the spin pays its natural ways win. The base game's own feature — and the ante depends on it.

rule.expands: every reel that has a wild ANYWHERE in its settled window becomes a fully wild reel
rule.pays: its ordinary ways win on the expanded board — no multiplier of any kind
rule.whyNotOnBoughtRounds: the expansion would run over the FORCED scatters and erase the trigger the player paid 100x or 200x for — gate on 'not a bought stage', not on 'not in free spins'
rule.whyNoBadge: tower multipliers are a free-spins mechanic; with badges on hot spins the same fit measures 103.09% instead of 96.36%

triggerSuppression.detail: if the expansion covers the cells the scatters landed on, the trigger is lost. This is fitted into the RTP — do NOT add a guard protecting scatters from the expansion.
triggerSuppression.measured: 10,962 suppressed triggers in a 20,000,000-round ante run

baseGameMaxWin.rule: all five reels hot at once + custom.fullBoardInstantMaxWin = the round pays maxWinMultiplier x bet immediately, in the BASE game
baseGameMaxWin.note: the max-win ceremony must fire here too, not only out of the bonus

randomness.why: the hot roll must not consume words from the reel-stop stream — reels must land identically with the feature on or off, or toggling it invalidates every certified figure

contribution.anteDependency: the ante measures ~84% with hot spins disabled — if they are ever dropped the ante MUST be re-fitted. buy3/buy4 are unaffected (hot never fires on a bought round).

referenceImpl.where: top of deriveViceRound — after the stops are derived, before the board is evaluated

presentation.reveal: the same tower reveal the free spins use (playExpandingWildReveal)
presentation.order: the reels land first, THEN the wild reels expand — the player must see the wilds arrive and grow, not find them already grown
